args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, contradicting the docstring and
tests/test_money.py expectations (banker's rounding). Import and apply
ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` implemented `round_money` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, breaking the nightly build (`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212).
- This PR changes the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and FIN-212 requirements.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch (commit 08d3cd5986) passed.

Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).
